full.label: Stabilise
full.visual: One confirmed number; steady idle; one accessible completion announcement

reduced.treatment: One confirmed digit replacement plus local accent/environment crossfade

off.treatment: Immediate supported apply with truthful ordinary status

fallback: Native effect unavailable => reduced/off; core state and use remain functional
failure_before_commit: Keep old canonical number; show real error; no success cue
failure_after_commit: Keep new canonical number; report partial apply; explicit reapply; no cinematic replay
